description: This source file defines the main activity for an Android application that displays a basic OpenGL surface view. It manages lifecycle events such as creation, pausing, and resuming, and initializes the custom surface view component.

classes.name: BasicGLSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: Main activity that hosts the OpenGL surface view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; initializes and sets the custom surface view.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is paused; pauses the surface view rendering.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is resumed; resumes the surface view rendering.
